description: Canonical tomato class map over agri_foundation_v1 labels. Source labels are kept in the manifest; this file only maps them.

excluded_labels.tomato_black_spot: Single-source class (tomatoleaf only, 108 images): label is confounded with source; kept on disk for future work.

merge_notes.spider_mites: Three spellings of the same pest label from PlantVillage, New Plant Diseases and PlantDoc.
merge_notes.yellow_leaf_curl_virus: PlantDoc 'Tomato leaf yellow virus' is TYLCV; merged with PlantVillage 'Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus'.

external_note: PlantDoc and PlantWild are in-the-wild photos held out entirely for external evaluation; never used for training, validation, calibration or threshold selection.
